stretch.task: Add a message to distinguish a missing password check from a missing second factor.
stretch.hint: Test the first condition before the second.
stretch.answer: If password is false -> password check failed; if password true but MFA false -> second factor needed.

mastery.task: Write tests for all four combinations of passwordValid and secondFactorValid, then explain why MFA cannot stop all forms of phishing.
mastery.answer: False/False Deny, False/True Deny, True/False Deny, True/True Allow. MFA limits use of a stolen password but doesn't eliminate account attacks.
